description: Implementation of AAudioEndpointManager class managing audio stream endpoints, including opening, closing, and searching for shared and exclusive endpoints in an Android audio system.

classes.name: AAudioEndpointManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing audio stream endpoints, handling their lifecycle and search operations.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current state of the endpoint manager, including active streams and counts.

methods.name: findExclusiveEndpoint_l
methods.description: Searches for an existing exclusive endpoint matching the given configuration.

methods.name: findSharedEndpoint_l
methods.description: Searches for an existing shared endpoint matching the given configuration.

methods.name: openEndpoint
methods.description: Opens an audio endpoint based on the request's sharing mode, either exclusive or shared.

methods.name: openExclusiveEndpoint
methods.description: Opens or steals an exclusive endpoint, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: openSharedEndpoint
methods.description: Opens or reuses a shared endpoint for input or output streams.

methods.name: closeEndpoint
methods.description: Closes a given endpoint, decrementing reference counts and closing if no longer in use.

methods.name: closeExclusiveEndpoint
methods.description: Closes an exclusive endpoint, removing it from the list if no longer referenced.

methods.name: closeSharedEndpoint
methods.description: Closes a shared endpoint, removing it from the list if no longer referenced.
